findings.claim: The template-version/pin coupling conflicted with the validator's v0.4.0 floor and copier's downgrade refusal under --vcs-ref. The revision drops --vcs-ref from just upgrade, keeps the template at the newest release with kmctl_ref choosing the CLI and package, drops r4, and r8 documents that model. This is the same decoupling kmctl-starter had, so no upgrade path is lost.
